zh: 目标只有两种：0101… 或 1010…。固定目标后，从左到右看每一位：更早开始的翻转已经确定，更晚开始的翻转碰不到当前位。
所以当前位与目标不符时，唯一的办法就是从当前位置开启一次长度为 k 的翻转；若窗口会越过末尾，这个目标就无解。用差分记录每个翻转何时结束，维护当前位被翻转次数的奇偶性。
对两种目标分别计算：开长度 n+1 的数组 end，parity=0，count=0；遍历 i：parity^=end[i]；若 (s[i]^parity)≠(目标首位^(i%2))，则当 i+k>n 时该目标无解，否则 parity^=1、end[i+k]^=1、count+1；取两种目标中可行者的最小 count，都不可行输出 −1。
en: There are only two targets: 0101... or 1010.... With the target fixed, look at positions from left to right: flips that start earlier are already decided, and flips that start later cannot touch the current position.

So when the current position disagrees with the target, the only option is to start a flip of length k right here; if the window would run past the end, that target is impossible. Record with a difference array where each flip ends, and keep the parity of flips covering the current position.

For each of the two targets: use an array end of size n+1, parity = 0, count = 0; for each i: parity ^= end[i]; if (s[i] ^ parity) != (first ^ (i % 2)), the target is impossible when i + k > n, otherwise set parity ^= 1, end[i+k] ^= 1 and add one to count; print the smallest count among feasible targets, or -1 if neither is feasible.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Fix each of the two targets 0101... and 1010... separately. Scan from left to right, maintaining the parity of the active flips; when the current position does not match, a window must be started at the current position, and if the window goes out of bounds that target has no solution.

## Correctness

When the current position is processed, flips starting earlier are already decided, and flips starting later cannot change the current position, so starting a flip here on a mismatch is the only choice. Flipping the same window twice cancels out and can never reduce the count. The unique greedy sequence for each target is optimal; take the minimum over the two targets.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
